x-k-k3-01.title: Yaa bixiyay lacagta jeebka?
x-k-k3-01.topic: Mawduucyada la dhaafay: yaa loola jeedaa
x-k-k3-01.goal: Ka gabagabee waxa uu mawduuc la dhaafay tilmaamayo, tilmaan caddaynta qoraalka, oo sheeg sida gabagabadu u beddesho marka tilmaan la saaro.
x-k-k3-01.material:
Laba fasalle, 지우 iyo 하나, ayaa ku sheekaysanaya hadal edeb leh -요. Kuuriyaanku badanaa wuxuu ka tagaa mawduuca (yaa ficilka sameeyay). (댁 = eray xushmad leh oo loogu yeedho guriga qof.)

지우: 어제 뭐 했어요?
하나: 할머니 댁에 갔어요. 맛있는 밥을 먹었어요. 용돈도 주셨어요.
지우: 좋았겠어요!
x-k-k3-01.thinking.0: Gabagabeynta mawduuc aan la sheegin dhowr tilmaan
x-k-k3-01.thinking.2: Dib u eegista gabagabada marka tilmaan laga saaro
x-k-k3-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu arkay dhammaadyada -요 iyo erayada 할머니, 친구, 용돈
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.prompt: Yaa siiyay 하나 lacagta jeebka (용돈도 주셨어요)?
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.0: Eeg dhammaadka 주셨어요 oo ku barbardhig 먹었어요 xariiqda ka horreysa.
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.hint.1: Liis garee qof kasta oo ka muuqda saddexda weedhood ee 하나.
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.a: Waa tan helay lacagta, fal maamuusaya kan sameeyay-na lagama isticmaalo nafta.
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.c: 지우 wuxuu weydiiyaa oo falcelin sameeyaa oo keliya; qoraalka waxba ma sheego inuu wax siiyay.
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.r.d: Qaabka falka wuxuu tilmaamayaa qof ay u eegto kor, ma aha fasalle isla da' ah.
x-k-k3-01.s.s1.explain: Qoraalku mawduuc ma magacaabo, laakiin qaabka falka wuxuu muujiyaa in bixiyuhu yahay qof la maamuusayo, qofka keliya ee sidaas ah sheekada ku jira waa 할머니, oo gurigeeda 하나 booqatay. 'Laga yaabo' waa sax: qoraalku si cad uma sheego.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.prompt: Qaybaha caddaynta kuwee ayaa taageera jawaabtaada? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.0: Doorasho kasta weydii: ma i sheegaa YAA, mise WAXA oo keliya?
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hel tilmaan ku saabsan falka iyo tilmaan ku saabsan goobta.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.o.a: 용돈 macnaheedu waa lacagta jeebka, sidaas darteed bixiyuhu waa inuu ka yimaado qoyska.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.a: Eraygu wuxuu magacaabayaa waxa la siiyay, ma aha cidda siisay.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.o.b: 맛있는 밥 wuxuu muujiyaa bixiyuhu sidoo kale wuxuu kariyay cuntada.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.r.b: Cunto iyo lacag waa ficillo kala duwan; waxba ma xidhiidhiyaan labadooda hal qof.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.o.c: 주셨어요 wuxuu ku jiraa qaab muujiya ixtiraam kan sameeyay.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.o.d: 하나 horeba wuxuu joogay gurigii 할머니 qof kale halkaas lagama sheegin.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.explain: Laba tilmaan ayaa wada shaqeeya: qaabka falka wuxuu sheegayaa nooca qofka bixiyaha ah, sheekaduna waxay sheegtaa yaa halkaas joogay. Lacagta jeebka iyo cuntadu waxba kama sheegaan bixiyaha.
x-k-k3-01.s.s2.acc.0: Qaabka falka waa tilmaanta kali ah ee ugu xooggan; d wuxuu ku daraa in macnaha sheekadu ku habboon yahay.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.prompt: Qiyaas 하나 yidhi '용돈도 줬어요' halkii '용돈도 주셨어요'. Maxaa beddelmaya?
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.0: Ka qaad tilmaanta s2 ee aad ka heshay mid ugu xooggan oo eeg waxa harsan.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.hint.1: Weydii qofkee ayaa weli ku habboon kari lahaa.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.o.a: Waxba ma beddelmaan; bixiyuhu weli si cad waa 할머니.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.r.a: Qaabka maamuuska wuxuu ahaa mid ka mid ah tilmaamaha cidhiidhiyay bixiyaha; la'aantiis tilmaantii way dhammaatay.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.o.b: Bixiyuhu hadda wuxuu noqon karaa saaxiib ama qof ka yar sidoo kale.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.r.c: Qoraalka waxba ma tilmaamaan 지우 mid ama mid kale.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.o.d: Weedhdu waxay noqon lahayd Kuuriyaan khaldan.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.r.d: '줬어요' waa weedh edeb leh oo caadi ah; waxay sido macluumaad yar oo ku saabsan bixiyaha.
x-k-k3-01.s.s3.explain: Qaabka maamuuska la'aantiis sheekadu weli waxay ku habboon tahay 할머니, laakiin mar dambe ma reebto dad kale. Kalsoonida jawaabtii ugu horreysay waa inay hoos u dhacdaa.

x-k-k3-02.title: Hal xariiq oo yaab leh oo isbarasho ah
x-k-k3-02.goal: Hel xariiqda isbarasho ee u dhawaaqaysa yaab leh, sheeg sababta, oo dib u qor si ay u dhawaaqdo si dabiici ah.
x-k-k3-02.material: Arday cusub, 이민수, ayaa isu barayaa fasalka. Shan xariiq ayaa la muujiyay. Hal xariiq ayaa u dhawaaqaysa yaab leh dhagaystaha Kuuriyaanka ah.
x-k-k3-02.thinking.0: Helidda xariiqda keliya ee yaabka leh
x-k-k3-02.thinking.1: Sharaxaadda sababta ay u yaabka leedahay
x-k-k3-02.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan qaabka 저는 ___예요/이에요 si uu u yidhaahdo magac
x-k-k3-02.s.s1.prompt: Xariiqdee ayaa u dhawaaqaysa yaab leh?
x-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.0: Akhri xariiq kasta si qaylo ah sidii aad ula hadlayso fasalkaaga. Midee ayaa dhagaystayaasha ka dhigi lahaa inay dhoola cadeeyaan?
x-k-k3-02.s.s1.hint.1: Eeg waxa isla markiiba magaca ka dambeeya.
x-k-k3-02.s.s1.explain: Xariiqda 2 waa yaab leh. 님 waa magac sharaf lagu daro magacyada dadka kale si loo muujiyo ixtiraam. Ku dhejinta magacaaga waxay u dhawaaqaysaa sidii aad is ammaanayso. Xariiqyada kale way ku habboon yihiin is-barasho fasal.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.0: Ka fikir goorta aad ku darto 님: 선생님? 친구? naftaada?
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.hint.1: Is barbardhig sida xariiqda 3 uga hadlayso hadlaha.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.a: Magac sharaf muujinaya ixtiraam ayaa lagu xiray magaca hadlaha laftiisa.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.b: Magacyada waxaa laga dambeyn karaa 은/는 oo keliya, weligood 이에요.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.b: 이에요 magaca ka dib waa habka caadiga ah ee loo yidhaahdo 'Waxaan ahay ___'; tani ma aha dhibaatada.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.c: Is-barashadu waa inay isticmaashaa 입니다, weligeed 이에요 maya.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.c: Labadaba waa edeb; xariiqda 5 waxay isticmaashaa 습니다 xariiqda 1-na waxay isticmaashaa 요, isku-dhafkuna waa caadi.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.o.d: Is-barashadu waa inaysan lahayn magaca qoyska.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.r.d: Bixinta magaca buuxa waa caadi; qaybta magaca ka dambeysa ayaa ah arrinta.
x-k-k3-02.s.s2.explain: Magaca sharafta 님 waa in lagu muujiyo ixtiraam qof kale. Isticmaal magacaaga la'aantiis.
x-k-k3-02.s.s3.prompt: Dib u qor xariiqda 2 si ay u dhawaaqdo si dabiici ah. Ku qor Kuuriyaan qaab edeb leh.
x-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.0: Ku hay 이민수 sida magaca oo dheh 'magacaygu waa ...' ama 'Waxaan ahay ...'.
x-k-k3-02.s.s3.hint.1: Hubi dhammaadka weedhdaada: waa inuu weli noqdaa edeb (요 ama 습니다).
x-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma ku haysay dhammaadka edebta leh?
x-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma ka tagay magaca sharafta magacayga?
x-k-k3-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Fasalle ma garan lahaa 'yaa' aan ahay?
x-k-k3-02.s.s3.modelNote.1: Qaab kale oo fiican oo ka fogaysa dhibaatada.

x-k-k3-03.title: Laga bilaabo fariin saaxiib ilaa fariin ayeeyo
x-k-k3-03.topic: Magacyada iyo heerarka hadalka: qorista ayeeyo
x-k-k3-03.goal: Go'aami qaybaha fariin caadi ah ee u baahan in la beddelo ayeeyo, oo dib u qor adigoo isticmaalaya qaabab edeb leh iyo erayo ku habboon 'aniga', 'adiga' iyo guriga.
x-k-k3-03.material:
하나 wuxuu tan u diray saaxiib dhow:

나 내일 학교 끝나고 너네 집에 가. 같이 밥 먹어.

(나 = aniga, 너네 집 = guriga qoyskaaga, 가 iyo 먹어 waa dhammaadyo caadi ah.) Waxay rabtaa inay u dirto ayeeyadeed 할머니 war ku dhow isku mid ah, oo gurigeeda ay berri booqan doonto.
x-k-k3-03.thinking.1: Dooridda qaababka edebta ah dhinaca nafta iyo dhinaca kale
x-k-k3-03.s.s1.prompt: Qaybaha fariinta saaxiibka kuwee ayaa u baahan in la beddelo 할머니? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
x-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.0: Weydii: haddii aan saaxiibka ku beddelo 할머니, erayadee ayaa weli macno samaynaya?
x-k-k3-03.s.s1.hint.1: Hubi saddex nooc oo erayo ah: 'aniga', 'gurigaaga', iyo sida weedhuhu u dhammaadaan.
x-k-k3-03.s.s1.r.a: Qaybtani waxay magacaabtaa wakhti mana ku xirna cidda dhagaysata.
x-k-k3-03.s.s1.explain: Erayga 'aniga', erayga guriga qofka kale iyo dhammaadyada weedhaha dhammaantood waxay ku xiran yihiin dhagaystaha. Weedhda wakhtigu ma ku xirna.
x-k-k3-03.s.s2.prompt: Dib u qor fariinta 할머니 Kuuriyaan. Ku bilow adigoo u yeedhaya 할머니.
x-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.0: Isticmaal erayga xushmadda ah ee 'aniga' iyo dhammaadyo edeb leh.
x-k-k3-03.s.s2.hint.1: Ku beddel 너네 집 weedh magacaabaysa qofka gurigiisa.
x-k-k3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma beddelay dhammaadka caadiga ah kasta?
x-k-k3-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma 할머니 ayaa dareemi lahayd ixtiraam akhrinta tan?
x-k-k3-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu isticmaalaa 집 iyo 밥, kuwaas oo ku habboon heerkan.

x-k-k3-04.title: Ka jawaab saaxiib qoraal ku saabsan qoyskaaga
x-k-k3-04.goal: Is barbardhig jawaabo gaaban si aad u aragto inta ay sheegayaan, ka dibna qor fariintaada 4-5 weedhood oo bixisa magacaaga, da'daada, xubnaha qoyska iyo hal isbarbardhig da'.
x-k-k3-04.material:
Saaxiib qoraal, 서준, ayaa kuu qoray:

안녕하세요! 저는 서준이에요. 열두 살이에요. 우리 가족은 다섯 명이에요. 형은 저보다 세 살 많아요. 가족을 소개해 주세요.
x-k-k3-04.thinking.0: Qiimeynta jawaabta ugu fiican ee su'aasha
x-k-k3-04.thinking.1: Doorashada macluumaadka akhristuhu u baahan yahay
x-k-k3-04.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan erayada xubnaha qoyska sida 아버지, 어머니, 동생
x-k-k3-04.prereq.2: Wuxuu arkay erayga 살 ee da'da
x-k-k3-04.s.s1.prompt: 서준 wuxuu rabaa inuu ogaado adiga iyo qoyskaaga. Jawaabteee ayaa siinaysa sawirka ugu cad?
x-k-k3-04.s.s1.hint.0: Samee liis waxa 서준 kuu sheegay iyo waxa uu weydiiyay.
x-k-k3-04.s.s1.r.a: Saaxiibtinimo, laakiin waxba kama sheegto da'deeda ama qoyskeeda, taasoo ah waxa 서준 weydiiyay.
x-k-k3-04.s.s1.r.b: Waxay sharaxdaa shaqooyinka waalidiinta laakiin waxay ka tagaysaa magaca qoraaga, da'da iyo isbarbardhig kasta sida kii 서준.
x-k-k3-04.s.s1.explain: Jawaabta c waxay bixisaa magac, da', xubnaha qoyska iyo isbarbardhig, taasoo waafaqsan fariinta 서준 laftiisa. Jawaabaha kale waa saaxiibtinimo ama faahfaahsan laakiin waxay seegaan waxa uu weydiiyay.
x-k-k3-04.s.s2.prompt: Qor jawaabtaada Kuuriyaan (4-5 weedhood oo gaaban). Ku dar magacaaga, da'daada, ugu yaraan hal xubin qoys, iyo hal isbarbardhig leh 보다 (tusaale, yaa ka weyn ama ka yar adiga). Isticmaal qaab edeb leh.
x-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.0: Ku bilow 저는 ___예요 ka dibna sheeg da'daada adigoo isticmaalaya 살.
x-k-k3-04.s.s2.hint.1: Isbarbardhigga, nuqul ka qaad qaabka weedhda 서준: ___은/는 저보다 ... 살 많아요/어려요.
x-k-k3-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma fariintaydu waxay 서준 u sheegaysaa magacayga iyo da'daydaba?
x-k-k3-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma isbarbar dhigu run buu yahay qoyskayga dhabta ah ama kan male-awaalka ah?
x-k-k3-04.s.s2.modelNote.1: Wuxuu isticmaalaa 오빠, kaas oo gabadh ugu yeedho walaalkeed ka weyn.

x-k-k3-05.title: Maxaad 민호 weydiin lahayd si aad u ogaato?
x-k-k3-05.topic: Da'da iyo xiriirka: macluumaadkee ayaa maqan
x-k-k3-05.goal: Go'aami haddii sharaxaad gaaban oo qoys ku filan tahay inay su'aal ka jawaabto, hel qaybta maqan, oo ku weydii su'aal Kuuriyaan ah oo edeb leh.
x-k-k3-05.material:
민호 wuxuu qoray:

저는 열 살이에요. 우리 가족은 다섯 명이에요. 할머니, 아버지, 어머니, 누나, 그리고 저예요. 누나는 저보다 나이가 많아요.

Waxaad rabtaa inaad si sax ah u ogaato imisa jir buu 누나 yahay.
x-k-k3-05.thinking.0: Xukunka in macluumaadku ku filan yahay

x-k-k3-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ku taxay dhowr da' oo ku habboon 'ka weyn 10'. Ma hal oo keliya baa jirta?

x-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.c: Maya. Waxaan u baahanahay da'da 아버지.

x-k-k3-05.s.s1.o.d: Maya. Waxaan u baahanahay dhalashada 민호.
x-k-k3-05.s.s1.r.d: Dhalashadiisa ma kuu sheegi lahayd wax ku saabsan 누나.
x-k-k3-05.s.s1.explain: Qoraalku wuxuu sheegayaa oo keliya inay ka weyn tahay 민호, taasoo oggolaata da' badan. Qaybta maqan waa intee ay ka weyn tahay (ama da'deeda lafteeda).
x-k-k3-05.s.s2.prompt: Saaxiibka 민호 wuxuu sidoo kale rabaa inuu ogaado haddii 할머니 ay tahay hooyada 아버지 mise hooyada 어머니. Weedhee cusub ee 민호 ayaa go'aamin lahayd? Dooro dhammaan kuwa khuseeya.

x-k-k3-05.s.s2.explain: Weedh kasta waxay magacowdaa dhinaca si toos ah, sidaa darteed way go'aamisaa su'aasha (jawaabo ka soo horjeedda). Da'da iyo wada noolaanshaha waxay ku habboon yihiin labada dhinac.

x-k-k3-05.s.s3.hint.0: Isticmaal 누나 su'aasha gudaheeda iyo erey ku saabsan da' ama sano (몇 살, 나이).

x-k-k3-06.title: Qofka qolka fadhiga ku jira

x-k-k3-06.thinking.2: Ogaanshaha sida macluumaad dheeraad ah u dhimo male-awaalka

x-k-k3-06.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Walaal ka yar si caadi ah ugama hadlaan sidan.
x-k-k3-06.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Qaabku fasal-wadaage isla da'da ma ku habboona.
x-k-k3-06.s.s1.st.1.after: Qofku wuxuu eegayaa 민지 oo wuxuu weydiinayaa haddii ay timid. 우리 강아지 waa naanays diirran oo ilmo loogu yeedho, sidaa darteed wuxuu tilmaamaa 민지.

x-k-k3-06.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Qofku wuxuu eegayaa 민지 marka uu tan leeyahay.
x-k-k3-06.s.s1.st.1.r.d: U yeedhidda ilmo la jecel yahay '강아지' waa naanays diirran oo caadi ah.
x-k-k3-06.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yaa hadda qolka fadhiga ku jira?
x-k-k3-06.s.s1.st.2.after: Waalid oo keliya ayaa ugu yeedhi kara nin weyn '아들'. Sidaa darteed qofku waa waalidka aabbaha 민지: ayeeyadeed ama awoowgeed dhinaca aabbaha.
x-k-k3-06.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hooyadeed ma ugu yeedhi lahayd 아버지 '아들'.
x-k-k3-06.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Macallin looma badna inuu ugu yeedho aabbaheed '아들'.

x-k-k3-06.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Walaal ka weyn ma ugu yeedhi lahayd 아버지 '아들'.
x-k-k3-06.s.s1.reflect: Marka hore 'qof la ixtiraamo' ayaa ku filnaa, laakiin tilmaan cusub kasta wuxuu meesha ka saaray doorashooyin. Tilmaanta ugu dambaysay waxay muujisay in suurtagalnimadii hore ee 'waalid' sidoo kale ay tegi lahayd. Ogow in aad beddeshay male-awaalkaaga caddayn awgeed, ma aha dareen.
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.prompt: Sababta 민지 uga tagi karto mawduuca iyadoo aan saaxiibkeed jahwareerin?
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.hint.0: Eeg qaybaha saddexda fariin ee aad isticmaashay si aad u male-awaasho.
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.hint.1: Weydii goorma ayaad u malaynaysaa in hadlaha mawduuca cod dhawaaqi lahaa.
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.o.a: Sababtoo ah weedhaha Kuuriyaanka weligood mawduuc ma leh.
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.r.a: Mawduucyada inta badan waa laga tagaa laakiin way jiraan; waa lagu dari karaa marka ay cadayn la'aan noqoto.
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.o.b: Sababtoo ah saaxiibkeed wuxuu wax walba ka yaqaan qoyskeeda.
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.r.b: Haddii taasi sabab oo dhan ahaan lahayd, tilmaamaha falalka muhiim ma ahaan lahayn.
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.o.c: Sababtoo ah qaabka falka iyo sheekadu horeyba waxay muujiyaan yaa la leeyahay.
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.o.d: Sababtoo ah ma ay hubin yaa qolka fadhiga ku jiray.
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.r.d: Si cad bay u ogtahay; sheekada si nidaamsan ayay u sheegaysaa.
x-k-k3-06.s.s2.explain: Dhegeystayaasha Kuuriyaanka waxay isticmaalaan qaababka falka iyo macnaha guud si ay u soo celiyaan mawduuca. Haddii runtii aan cadayn, hadlaha ayaa ku dari lahaa.

x-k-k3-07.title: Walaal mise walaasha? Hubi erayada
x-k-k3-07.topic: Xiriirka: erayada qoyska ee ku xidhan yaa hadlaya
x-k-k3-07.goal: Hel eraygii qoyska ee aan ku habboonayn hadlaha, dooro eraygii saxda ah, oo tijaabi waxa isbeddela haddii hadluhu uu yahay qof kale.
x-k-k3-07.material: 하나 waa gabadh. Waxay leedahay hal walaal ka weyn (15 jir) iyo hal walaal ka weyn oo gabadh ah (17 jir). Waxay qoyskeeda ugu soo bandhigaysaa fasalkeeda.
x-k-k3-07.thinking.0: Helidda erey la yaab leh iyadoo la isticmaalayo macluumaadka hadlaha
x-k-k3-07.thinking.2: Hubinta sida isbeddelka hadlaha u beddelo xukunka
x-k-k3-07.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan in Kuuriyaanku leeyahay erayo badan oo walaal ka weyn ah
x-k-k3-07.s.s1.prompt: Sadarkee ayaa leh eray qoys oo aan ku habboonayn 하나?
x-k-k3-07.s.s1.hint.0: Calaamadee yaa wiil yaa gabadh ku ah sheekada. Erayada qoys ee kee ayaa ku xidhan taas?
x-k-k3-07.s.s1.hint.1: Isbarbar dhig labada sadar ee magacaabaya walaal ka weyn.
x-k-k3-07.s.s1.explain: Sadarka 3 waa kan aan ku habboonayn. Gabadh walaalkeeda ka weyn waxay ugu yeedhaa 오빠, ma aha 형. Wiil wuxuu isticmaali lahaa 형. Sadarka 4 waa fiican yahay sababtoo ah gabadh walaasheeda ka weyn waxay ugu yeedhaa 언니.
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.prompt: Eraygee ayaa beddeli lahaa 형 sadarka 3?
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ma qofka wuu ka weyn yahay mise wuu ka yar yahay 하나?
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.r.a: 누나 waa eraygii wiil ugu yeedho walaasheeda ka weyn; halkan walaalku waa wiil.
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.r.b: 동생 macnaheedu waa walaal ka yar, laakiin isagu waa 15 oo ka weyn yahay 하나.
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.r.d: 아버지 waa aabbaha; sadarku wuxuu ku saabsan yahay walaal.
x-k-k3-07.s.s2.explain: Gabadh walaalkeeda ka weyn waxay ugu yeedhaa 오빠. Sadarku wuxuu noqonayaa 우리 오빠는 열다섯 살이에요.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.prompt: Hadda ka fikir 하나 inuu yahay wiil leh isla qoyska (hal walaal ka weyn iyo hal walaal ka weyn oo gabadh ah). Sadarrada kee ayaa u baahan beddel?
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.hint.0: Sadarka 3 iyo sadarka 4 si gooni ah u tijaabi hadlaha cusub.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.hint.1: Walaal kasta u qor eraygii saxda ahaa ee wiil.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.r.b: Wiil 형 waa eraygii saxda ahaa, sidaa darteed sadarka 3 wuu fiicnaan lahaa.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.r.c: Mid ka mid ah labada eray oo keliya ayaa joogsan lahaa ku habboonaanta.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.r.d: Eray kasta la barbar dhig hadlaha cusub.
x-k-k3-07.s.s3.explain: Wiil, 형 (walaal ka weyn) waa sax, laakiin walaal ka weyn oo gabadh ah waa 누나, ma aha 언니. Sidaa darteed sadarka 4 ayaa isbeddeli lahaa.

x-k-k3-08.title: Ma kula hadli kartaa qoyska si caadi ah?
x-k-k3-08.goal: Ku xukun sheegasho ku saabsan hadalka xubnaha qoyska, hel qaybaha sax ah iyo kuwa aan ahayn, oo qor hal weedh walaal iyo hal weedh ayeeyo/awoowe.
x-k-k3-08.material:
Laba saaxiib ayaa ka hadlaya sida loola hadlo qoyska.

하나: 가족한테는 항상 반말을 써도 돼. 우리 가족이잖아.
준: 아니야. 할머니한테 '밥 먹었어?' 하면 안 돼.
(반말 = hadal caadi ah oo aan lahayn -요 edebta.)
(Erayada ixtiraamka ee cunista: 드시다, 진지, 식사하시다.)
x-k-k3-08.thinking.0: Qiimaynta sheegasho guud iyadoo la isticmaalayo tusaale lid ku ah
x-k-k3-08.thinking.1: Ogaanshaha in hal tusaale lid ku ah jebiyo 'had iyo jeer' laakiin ma jebiyo 'mararka qaarkood'
x-k-k3-08.thinking.2: Soo saarista laba weedh oo laba dhegeystayaal ah
x-k-k3-08.prereq.1: Wuxuu arkay dhammaadyada caadi ah iyo kuwa edeb leh labadaba
x-k-k3-08.prereq.2: Wuxuu isticmaali karaa erayada ixtiraamka 드시다, 진지, 식사하시다 ayeeyo/awoowe
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.prompt: Bayaannada kee ayaa ku saabsan doodan caddaalad ah? Dooro dhammaan kuwa khuseeya.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.hint.0: Maxay hal tusaale lid ku ah caddayn lahayd, maxayse ma caddayn lahayn?
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ka fikir yaa qof badanaa si caadi ah ula hadlo guriga.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.o.a: '항상' aad ayay u xoog badan tahay: hal tusaale sida 할머니 ayaa ku filan inuu su'aal geliyo.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.o.b: Qoysaska way kala duwan yihiin: qaar waxay hadal caadi ah la isticmaalaan waalidka, kuwo kale ma isticmaalaan, sidaa darteed xeer keliya ma ku habboona qoys kasta.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.o.c: Xubnaha qoysku way dhow yihiin, sidaa darteed looma baahna in guriga laga fikiro edebta.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.r.c: Tani waxay celinaysaa sheegashada 하나 halkii ay tijaabin lahayd.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.o.d: Tusaalaha 준 wuxuu muujinayaa in hadalka caadiga ah ee xubnaha qoyska ay khalad tahay.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.r.d: Hal tusaale oo ku saabsan 할머니 ma daboolo walaal ka yar ama qoys kasta; wuxuu jebiyaa 'had iyo jeer' oo keliya.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.explain: Sheegashada 'had iyo jeer caadi' waxaa jebiya hal tusaale lid ku ah, laakiin taasi macnaheedu ma aha 'weligeed caadi ma aha'. Qoysaska dhabta ahi way kala duwan yihiin, xiriirkuna wuu go'aamiyaa.
x-k-k3-08.s.s1.acc.0: Ogaanshaha daciifnimada '항상' waa qodobka muhiimka ah; b wuxuu ku daraa in qoysaska ay kala duwan yihiin.
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.prompt: Qor laba su'aal oo gaagaaban oo Kuuriyaan ah oo weydiinaya haddii qofka wax cunay: mid walaalkaaga ka yar iyo mid ayeeyadaada ama awoowahaaga.
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.hint.0: Walaalka ka yar isticmaal dhammaad caadi ah. Ayeeyo/awoowe isticmaal dhammaad edeb leh iyo mid ka mid ah erayada ixtiraamka ee 'cun' ee qoraalka kor ku yaal.
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ku dhig 할머니 ama 할아버지 weedha labaad.
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ma isticmaalay dhammaadyo kala duwan labada qof?
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ma weedha ayeeyo/awoowaha waxay u egtahay ixtiraam?
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ma su'aal kasta runtii waxay ku saabsan tahay cunista?
x-k-k3-08.s.s2.modelNote.2: Lammaane kale oo aan rasmi ahayn iyo edeb leh.

x-k-k3-09.title: Intee da' ayuu qoyska yeelan karaa?
x-k-k3-09.topic: Da'da iyo xiriirka: dhowr qoys ayaa ku habboon
x-k-k3-09.goal: Akhri tilmaamaha da'da ee Kuuriyaanka, arag inay dhowr suurtagal ka tagayaan, oo dhis qoysas kala duwan oo qanciya dhammaan tilmaamaha.
x-k-k3-09.material:
민수 wuxuu qoyskiisa sharraxayaa:

저는 12살이에요.
형은 저보다 2살이나 3살 많아요.
아버지는 형보다 28살에서 32살 많아요.
할머니는 아버지보다 25살에서 32살 많아요.
할머니는 75살보다 어려요.

(Dhammaan da'du waa tirooyin dhan.)
